notes.title: Toribash Next 1.3
notes.content:
[h2]Hi, Toribash Next 1.3 update is now available![/h2]
[i]This update features Steam Workshop integration for mod sharing, various performance improvements, more bug fixes and other tweaks[/i]


[h3]Mod sharing via Workshop[/h3]
[b]You can now share any created mod on Steam Workshop for other players to try![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36605742/12287b08b99b61d5d6f615dda71b2bb057821b98.png[/img]
Right-click on your mod listing in Mods menu and choose "Upload to Workshop" option from the tooltip menu to access the upload screen.
In addition to mod name, you can specify an optional description and upload a preview of your mod to make it easier for others to recognize it - both in Workshop browser and in Mods menu.

[h3]Other updates in TBN v1.3[/h3]
[list][*]Tweaks to Classic, Aikido and Samurai Fight game modes
[*]Joint tooltip now also shows joint name in addition to its state
[*]Added 'V' hotkey to quickly toggle all grips on or off
[*]Any events caused by player collisions (score gain, fractures, dismembers, etc) during stancing are now ignored
[*]Improvements to mod saver to drastically decrease output file size by preventing duplicate data
[*]Netcode improvements for faster mod syncing for newly joined players
[*]Being left alone in a multiplayer room now instantly makes you its operator
[*]Fixed bug with tab menu potentially getting stuck when opening main menu while it hasn't finished animating
[*]Various fixes to prevent incorrect replay / mod data parsing during p2p transfers
[*]Fixed bug with 3D items, effect items and head texture not showing correctly[/list]

tags.feature: Added 'V' hotkey to quickly toggle all grips on or off

tags.bug: Fixed bug with tab menu potentially getting stuck when opening main menu while it hasn't finished animating
Various fixes to prevent incorrect replay / mod data parsing during p2p transfers
Fixed bug with 3D items, effect items and head texture not showing correctly

notes.title: Toribash Next 1.2 - 27/01/24 Update
notes.content:
[b]This update features more bug fixes and minor improvements to Toribash Next:[/b]
[list][*]Fixed crash after inventory load that was affecting some users
[*]Fixed potential data parsing failure crashes while in Multiplayer
[*]Fixed bug that was causing connection errors when attempting to join a new room after leaving multiplayer
[*]Fixed UI bug that was leading to buttons in Play screen to retain pressed state
[*]Fixed bug that was leading to incorrect currency display in ToriCoins purchase screen for some regions that use USD
[*]Match intro tweaks to ensure correct info display after joining new room
[*]Disabled "Disconnected" Play screen state due to redundancy as game client now instantly enters offline mode with last game state upon leaving online room
[*]Updated X hotkey to enable Hold state by default instead of Relax[/list]

If you experience an issue that has not been addressed by this most recent update, please email a description to tbnsupport@nabistudios.com and we’ll check it out.

Thanks for any feedback! We greatly appreciate your support as we continue to refine and improve Toribash Next. Please check back here for more updates coming in the near future.

notes.title: Toribash Next 0.82 - 25/05/22
notes.content:
[h3]Hi, Toribash Next 0.82 is now available![/h3]
[i]Please note that this release bumps up net version to 0.82 - players on earlier builds will not be able to see / join your rooms (and vice versa).[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36605742/83ee0bfad36e045c37d868125669aa1d21c85975.png[/img]

[h3]Big stuff[/h3]
[list][*]Customizable head textures and editor (can be accessed from Inventory)
[*]Performance improvements (expect significantly better performance, especially on lower end hardware)
[*]Breaking changes to stancing: stance frames value needs to be 10x lower than before[/list]

[b]Other changes[/b]
[list][*]Fixed colors order for player 3 and 4
[*]Display name prefix (@) for active fighters if one is applicable
[*]Increased raycast distance to make sure you can select players from afar
[*]Increased freecam movement speed
[*]Chat size toggle with backquote (`)
[*]Prevent mouse cursor from going outside the window
[*]Custom cursor image that reacts to hovering over buttons / players
[*]Translucent camera avatars for spectators
[*]Fixed environment ghost materials
[*]Updated ghosts to be always drawn behind regular objects
[*]Tweaked chat input window size to prevent it from overlaying player info text
[*]Game modes screen design is now in line with other screens
[*]Fixed bug with extra joint spawning in main menu's player preview[/list]


[b]Join Toribash Next discussion channel: [url=https://discord.gg/KSM3hT7]https://discord.gg/KSM3hT7[/url][/b]
